name: Frisco Independent School District
districtFact: Frisco ISD spans approximately 75 square miles in Collin and Denton counties, and its official district overview lists 12 high schools.

about.title: About Frisco Independent School District
about.content: Frisco ISD serves students across approximately 75 square miles in Collin and Denton counties, including most of Frisco and portions of Plano, McKinney, and Little Elm. This calendar resource covers districtwide student dates; campus events, bell schedules, and attendance-zone information should be confirmed through Frisco ISD.

compareIntro: Compare Frisco ISD with nearby districts using the same school year. The table focuses on first and last days, October no-school dates, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break.

relatedDistricts.name: Plano Independent School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Plano ISD shares Frisco’s Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break dates in 2026–27 but schedules a named Fall Break October 12–16.

relatedDistricts.name: McKinney Independent School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: McKinney ISD starts August 13 and ends May 27 in 2026–27; its Spring Break matches Frisco’s March 15–19 dates.

relatedDistricts.name: Dallas Independent School District
